cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my enthusiastic interest in the Junior Digital Tracking Specialist position at MAP. Having followed MAP's innovative approach to digital media and communication optimization for clients like Coca-Cola and BMW, I am particularly drawn to your commitment to advanced data analysis and delivering high service levels. My experience as a Junior Digital Marketer, coupled with a robust technical background, aligns perfectly with the demands of this role, and I am keen to contribute to your team in Brussels.

My technical foundation, notably my experience as a Front-End Developer utilizing JavaScript and AngularJS, provides a strong basis for understanding and implementing the technical specifications and script tags required for optimal online campaign tracking. At Episto, I am responsible for building and maintaining client websites in WordPress, which involves ensuring technical accuracy and content deployment. Furthermore, on mirook.com, I actively implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema) and conducted technical SEO audits, demonstrating a practical ability to manage and validate code for improved digital visibility, directly transferable to generating and testing action tracking codes.

I am proficient in leveraging analytical tools such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, and Ahrefs to track site performance and guide strategic decisions. This data-driven approach positions me to effectively analyze digital media plans, ensure campaigns are set up according to reporting needs, and contribute meaningfully to conversion tagging strategies. My client-facing experience at Episto has honed my communication skills, which are essential for liaising with creative agencies, planners, and clients to ensure smooth campaign deployment and issue resolution. I am also comfortable communicating in both English and Dutch (B1, actively improving).

I am a proactive problem-solver with a meticulous attention to detail, consistently striving for accuracy in all tasks. My willingness to learn and expand my knowledge is continuous, and I am excited by the prospect of growing within MAP’s supportive and flexible environment. I am confident that my blend of technical skills, analytical aptitude, and client-focused approach makes me a strong candidate for this role.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I am available for an interview at your earliest convenience to discuss how my qualifications can benefit MAP.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
